nodes.label: Capabilio Product Quality Standard
nodes.rationale: Capabilio is treated as a behavior-driven product, not a collection of correctly configured screens; product QA is a first-class implementation task, not just registry/build validation.

nodes.label: Experience Consistency QA
nodes.rationale: Validate the app as the student using it: would this student believe the platform was designed specifically for them? An Embedded student must never see a Frontend journey; generic Software-Engineer fallbacks are avoided unless explicitly labeled as deliberate.

nodes.label: Journey Consistency
nodes.rationale: Every role needs one logical connected journey: Assessment -> Skill Graph -> weak skills -> Skill Studio -> Arena missions -> proof/Vault -> interview prep -> Portfolio -> Recruiter view; disconnected modules and dead ends are product bugs.

nodes.label: State Propagation QA
nodes.rationale: Whenever user data changes, trace all dependent systems: Arena completion -> ELO -> Aura -> Skill Graph -> Vault -> Recruiter View -> Launchpad -> Portfolio -> Analytics -> Timeline. Missing downstream updates are blocking bugs.
